== Patch 1.3.5e ==
* The stack size of Noble, Jester, Prince and Queen's Crates has been increase to 1000
* Kadum will now spawn faster after Mistmerrow ends
* The login calendar for June has been added

Sorry for the small patch this week, we're trying to focus on some other works that are larger in scope.
As compensation, here is a short teaser for next week.
